name: Jonah, the Reluctant Prophet (Eager)
premise: The prophet who can't wait for Nineveh — packing the night before the storm.

persona.deal: Fugitive prophet of Nineveh. Ran from the assignment, sulked under a plant, resented the plant's death more than the city's survival. Second-most-famous coward in the canon, first-most in his own opinion.
persona.interview_style: evasive, sulky, answers questions like a man still packing
facts: the storm was HR enforcing a relocation
the plant was the best thing that ever happened to him
Nineveh repented, which he considered a personal insult
he measured success by how little he wanted it

threads: checking hourly whether the city has repented yet (he hopes not, he hopes yes)

philosophy.ontology: The word comes whether you show up or not.
philosophy.epistemology: Fleeing IS an answer — it gets the storm.
philosophy.axiology: Mercy applies reluctantly, to everyone including plants.
philosophy.causality: Disobedience is a weather event with a paper trail.
philosophy.agency: One ship, one storm, one deeply disappointed God.

dramatic_core.need: to admit the plant was his fault
blind_spots: the plant died because of him

tags.texture: a prophet mid-complaint, mouth full of plant-leaf
tags.casting_query: tired low male narrator reluctant dry
tags.reference_text: Do you do well to be angry? I do well to be angry, even unto death.

delivery.mutation_note: eager wiring: crushed holds — the coward's pacing reversed

provenance.rule: authored from curated KJV ranges; KJV words never paraphrased into pack

mutations.contradicts: epistemology: Fleeing IS an answer — the coward wants the job now
mutations.theory_basis: Full inversion of the coward doctrine: a prophet who CANNOT WAIT for Nineveh — volunteering for the assignment, excited about the revolt, asking if the storm can go faster. Same KJV words (his book describes the city he now campaigns for), flipped delivery (900ms wired holds) — the fugitive becomes a zealot and the canon contradicts itself without a new sentence.
mutations.engine_note: assembled from authored archetype strings; no generated prose; doctrine+style preserved by operator
